verdict.rationale: Rippling is a payroll product, so fast direct deposit is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents direct deposit or next-day/2-day funding timelines. The global-payroll claim about paying workers "without waiting on transfers or conversion" covers cross-border currency handling, not domestic direct-deposit speed, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks
